name: Talon
slug: A Talon is a chosen instrument of the Raven Queen’s order who acts with purpose rather than as an indiscriminate killer.
description: A Talon is an agent or chosen instrument of the Raven Queen’s order, acting with purpose in service to her will. The term is distinguished from “butcher,” suggesting that a Talon is not simply an indiscriminate killer but a deliberate and purposeful operative.

log.summary: During the session, the Raven Queen identified Sylan as a **Talon of her order**. The title distinguishes Sylan from a butcher, emphasizing that a Talon is a purposeful agent or chosen instrument who acts with intent rather than as an indiscriminate killer.
notes: The Raven Queen identifies Sylan as a talon of her order.
